#Data cleaning and prep ##Importing data

data <- read.csv("/Users/arthurevans/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Work/Research stuff/Platinum dataset stuff /Data/All platinum patients combined .csv", header = TRUE)

##Classifying variables

data$Age.at.diagnosis <- as.numeric(data$Age.at.diagnosis)

                                        levels = c("TP_TE", "EP_EMA"),

                                        ordered = FALSE)

                                                      "PSTT",
                                                      "Persistent mole"),

                          ordered = FALSE)

                                                   levels = c (0,1), 
                                                   labels = c("no", "yes"),
                                                   ordered = FALSE)

                                               labels = c("no", "yes"),
                                               ordered = FALSE)
data$Risk.score.at.diagnosis <- as.numeric(data$Risk.score.at.diagnosis)
data$Stage.at.diagnosis <- factor(data$Stage.at.diagnosis, 
                                  levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"),
                                  ordered = FALSE)
data$HCG.at.diagnosis..IU.L. <- as.numeric(data$HCG.at.diagnosis..IU.L.)
data$Lung_mets <- factor(data$Lung_mets, levels = c(0, 1), 
                         labels = c("no metastasis", "metastasis"),
                         ordered = FALSE)

                          levels = c(0,1), 
                          labels = c("no metastasis", "metastasis"),
                          ordered = FALSE)

                          levels = c(0,1), 
                          labels = c("no metastasis", "metastasis"),
                          ordered = FALSE)

                           levels = c(0,1), 
                           labels = c("no metastasis", "metastasis"),
                           ordered = FALSE)

                           levels = c(0,1), 
                           labels = c("no metastasis", "metastasis"),
                           ordered = FALSE)
data$Pacreas_mets <- factor(data$Pacreas_mets, 
                            levels = c(0,1),
                            labels = c("no metastasis", "metastasis"),
                            ordered = FALSE)
data$Bone_mets <- factor(data$Bone_mets, 
                         levels = c(0,1), 
                         labels = c("no metastasis", "metastasis"),
                         ordered = FALSE)
data$Abdo_wall_mets <- factor(data$Abdo_wall_mets, 
                              levels = c(0,1), 
                              labels = c("no metastasis", "metastasis"),
                              ordered = FALSE)

                       levels = c(0,1),

                       ordered = FALSE)

                          levels = c(0,1), 
                          labels = c("no metastasis", "metastasis"),
                          ordered = FALSE)
data$Previous_EMA <- as.numeric(data$Previous_EMA)
data$Previous_EMA.CO <- as.numeric(data$Previous_EMA.CO)

data$Previous_Actinomycin.D.Etoposide <- as.numeric(data$Previous_Actinomycin.D.Etoposide)
data$Previous_CarboAUC24 <- as.numeric(data$Previous_CarboAUC24)
data$No_Prior_chemo <- factor(data$No_Prior_chemo,
                                 levels = c(0,1),
                                 labels = c("had_prior_chemo", "no_prior_chemo"), 
                              ordered = FALSE)

                           levels = c("no", "yes_primary", "yes_secondary"),
                           ordered = FALSE)

                                        levels = c("Complete", "partial", "None"),
                                        ordered = FALSE)

data$Alive. <- as.factor(data$Alive.)

data$HCG.at.platinum.failure <- as.numeric(data$HCG.at.platinum.failure)
data$HCG.at.platinum.failure[is.na(data$HCG.at.platinum.failure)] <- 0
data$Nausea <- factor(data$Nausea)

data$Historectomy <- factor(data$Historectomy, 
                            levels = c("1", "0"),
                            labels = c("yes", "no"))
data$Resstcion.of.Mets <- factor(data$Resstcion.of.Mets, 
                            levels = c("1", "0"),
                            labels = c("yes", "no"))

##Generating secondary variables based on the original data collected

data$HCG.fall <- data$HCG_at_platinum_start - data$HCG.at.platinum.failure
data$HCG_percentage_change <- (data$HCG.fall / data$HCG_at_platinum_start ) *-100
data$hCG_at_platinum_start_scaled <- scale(data$HCG_at_platinum_start, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
data$Overall_patient_number <- 1:nrow(data)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Risk_category_at_diagnosis = factor(case_when(
    `Risk.score.at.diagnosis` >= 1 & `Risk.score.at.diagnosis` <= 6  ~ "low risk",
    `Risk.score.at.diagnosis` >= 7 & `Risk.score.at.diagnosis` <= 11 ~ "high risk",
    `Risk.score.at.diagnosis` >= 13                                  ~ "ultra-high risk"),
  levels = c("low risk", "high risk", "ultra-high risk"), 
  ordered = TRUE))
data$hCG_CR <- fct_collapse(data$First_platinum_response.,
                                              no = c("partial", "None"))
data$First_platinum_response. <- relevel(data$hCG_CR, ref = "no")
data$Non_term_pregnancies <- data$Gravidity - data$Parity

#RESULTS 4.0 ###4.1 Patient clinico-pathologic characteristics and Cisplatin regimen use cases ####Splitting dataset for various indications. Separate datasets were created for the EP/EMA and TP/TE cohorts as well as sub-data sets based on risk category and histological diagnosis.

split_data <- split(data, data$first_platinum_treatment)
EP_EMA_data <- as.data.frame(split_data$EP_EMA)
TP_TE_data <- as.data.frame(split_data$TP_TE)

EP_EMA_chorio_and_moles <- EP_EMA_data %>%
  filter(Histology. %in% c("Choriocarcinoma", "Persistent mole"))

EP_EMA_UHR <- EP_EMA_data %>%
  filter(No_Prior_chemo %in% "no_prior_chemo" & Histology. %in% c("Choriocarcinoma", "Persistent mole"))

EP_EMA_refractory_patients <- EP_EMA_data %>%
  filter(No_Prior_chemo %in% "had_prior_chemo" & Histology. %in% c("Choriocarcinoma", "Persistent mole"))

####Investigating dataset wide correlations for help selecting variabls for future modeling

df <- All_chorio_and_persistent_mole
numeric_variables <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
numeric_variables <- numeric_variables[sapply(df[numeric_variables], function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)]
factor_variables <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.factor)]
all_variables <- c(numeric_variables, factor_variables)
factor_variables <- factor_variables[sapply(df[factor_variables], function(x) nlevels(x) > 1)]
vars <- c(numeric_variables, factor_variables)


numeric_numeric_association <- function(x, y) {
  valid_idx <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  x <- x[valid_idx]
  y <- y[valid_idx]
  if (length(unique(x)) < 2 | length(unique(y)) < 2) return(NA)
  cor(x, y, method = "spearman")
}
factor_factor_association <- function(x, y) {
  valid_idx <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  x <- droplevels(x[valid_idx])
  y <- droplevels(y[valid_idx])
  if (nlevels(x) < 2 | nlevels(y) < 2) return(NA)
  vcd::assocstats(table(x, y))$cramer
}
numeric_factor_association <- function(num, cat) {
  valid_idx <- !is.na(num) & !is.na(cat)
  num <- num[valid_idx]
  cat <- droplevels(cat[valid_idx])  # <-- THIS is the key
  if (nlevels(cat) < 2 | length(unique(num)) < 2) return(NA)
  DescTools::EtaSq(aov(num ~ cat), type = 1)[1, "eta.sq"]
}


correlation_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(vars), ncol = length(vars))
rownames(correlation_matrix) <- vars
colnames(correlation_matrix) <- vars

for (i in vars) {
  for (j in vars) {
    if (i == j) {
      correlation_matrix[i, j] <- 1
    } 
    else if (i %in% numeric_variables & j %in% numeric_variables) {
      correlation_matrix[i, j] <- numeric_numeric_association(df[[i]], df[[j]])
    } 
    else if (i %in% factor_variables & j %in% factor_variables) {
      correlation_matrix[i, j] <- factor_factor_association(df[[i]], df[[j]])
    } 
    else if (i %in% numeric_variables & j %in% factor_variables) {
      correlation_matrix[i, j] <- numeric_factor_association(df[[i]], df[[j]])
    } 
    else if (i %in% factor_variables & j %in% numeric_variables) {
      correlation_matrix[i, j] <- numeric_factor_association(df[[j]], df[[i]])
    }
  }
}

)

Combined_response_first_logistic_regression <- glm(hCG_CR ~ 
                                                     Risk.score.at.diagnosis +
                                                     Antecedent.pregnancy.interval..months. +
                                                     First_platinum_cycles +
                                                     first_platinum_treatment, 
                                                   family = binomial,
                                                   data = All_chorio_and_persistent_mole)

summary(Combined_response_first_logistic_regression)
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = hCG_CR ~ Risk.score.at.diagnosis + Antecedent.pregnancy.interval..months. + 
##     First_platinum_cycles + first_platinum_treatment, family = binomial, 
##     data = All_chorio_and_persistent_mole)
## 
## Coefficients:
##                                        Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)  
## (Intercept)                            -0.38034    1.69564  -0.224    0.823  
## Risk.score.at.diagnosis                -0.02842    0.13881  -0.205    0.838  
## Antecedent.pregnancy.interval..months. -0.01293    0.02437  -0.531    0.596  
## First_platinum_cycles                  -0.40402    0.34034  -1.187    0.235  
## first_platinum_treatmentEP_EMA          3.94792    1.83048   2.157    0.031 *
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## (Dispersion parameter for binomial family taken to be 1)
## 
##     Null deviance: 34.296  on 24  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 23.061  on 20  degrees of freedom
##   (5 observations deleted due to missingness)
## AIC: 33.061
## 
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 5
BIC(Combined_response_first_logistic_regression)
## [1] 39.15516
logLik(Combined_response_first_logistic_regression)
## 'log Lik.' -11.53039 (df=5)
pR2(Combined_response_first_logistic_regression)
## fitting null model for pseudo-r2
##         llh     llhNull          G2    McFadden        r2ML        r2CU 
## -11.5303893 -17.1482450  11.2357114   0.3276053   0.3620073   0.4850271
emm_binomial <- emmeans(
  Combined_response_first_logistic_regression, ~ first_platinum_treatment,
  type = "response"
)
hCG_CR_emmeans_df <- as.data.frame(emm_binomial)

All_chorio_and_persistent_mole <- All_chorio_and_persistent_mole |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    hCG_CR = ifelse(hCG_CR == "Complete", 1, 0)
  )
hCG_CR_predicted_probability_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_jitter(data = All_chorio_and_persistent_mole, aes(x= first_platinum_treatment, y = hCG_CR, colour = first_platinum_treatment),
              width = 0.1,
              height = 0.1,
              alpha = 0.5, 
              size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = hCG_CR_emmeans_df, aes (x = first_platinum_treatment, y = prob, colour = first_platinum_treatment),
             size = 3) + 
  geom_errorbar(data = hCG_CR_emmeans_df, aes(x = first_platinum_treatment, 
             ymin = asymp.LCL, 
             ymax = asymp.UCL, 
             colour = first_platinum_treatment), 
             width = 0.15) +
    labs(
    x = "First CBC",
    y = "Adjusted probability of hCG_CR"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("Predicted probability of hCG_CR by first CBC")
print(hCG_CR_predicted_probability_plot)
